verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical, and both share serious flaws. The legal text becomes a five-line column at the right edge, about the same size as the offer copy, so it competes with the content around it. The red sale banner is tilted and pressed against the bottom edge. The headline wraps into a cramped three-line stack, and the bottle shot is shrunk so small its label can't be read. A keeps the SOLSTICE logo at a readable size, although it sits tight above the banner. In B the logo has shrunk to a barely readable speck, which weakens the brand, so A is slightly better.
